summary_claims.claim: Annex I is addressed to public-sector members who lead AI projects, develop or adopt technologies or draft specifications
In force from publication in the Boletín Oficial on 2 Jun 2023

note: Official database text supports every field. Resolución 111/2024 of the Ministry of Justice is listed as complementing the Disposición; I read its text on argentina.gob.ar (norma-397996) and it cites the Disposición only in its recitals and neither modifies nor repeals it, so status stands. Search found no repeal.
